findings.title: Edge ingress standard
findings.detail: External APIs publish only through Azure API Management with OAuth2 validation before traffic reaches AKS ingress controllers.

findings.title: Kubernetes runtime
findings.detail: Microservices run on AKS with Azure CNI overlay; internal east-west calls rely on mTLS via service mesh sidecars.

findings.title: Workload identity
findings.detail: Workload identity with federated credentials replaces static secrets for calling Key Vault and Azure Storage data plane.
